review_scope: Black/navy with a dense blue square-grid torso field, solid dark sleeves and silver/blue collar/cuff trim plus three silver shoulder strips. Two worn source fronts establish square spacing and field extent; square brightness simplified to one flat ink with minor size variation. All white logos/sponsor removed. Colors are visual estimates. limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
